text: Welcome.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I am Philemon, a dweller\nbetween consciousness and\nunconsciousness.
And now, a simple test:
Can you state your name?
Splendid.
There aren't many who can remember\ntheir identity when in this domain.
It seems you passed that test.
But tell me this: are you aware\nof the many and varied selves\nyou harbor within you?
The selves effused with divine love,
the self capable of demonic cruelty...
People live by wearing different masks.
Your current self may be only one\nof those innumerable masks.
You, though... You have a very firm\ngrip on your identity.
I respect your strong will, and in\nreturn I grant this power -
Persona.
It is the power to summon the selves\nwithin you, the gods and the\ndemons you harbor.
The time is soon when you\nwill need this power.
Now you must return
to your proper time and place.
We meet again, my friends.
Are you used to your Personas now?
As you have seen for yourselves,\nevents are moving in an\nunexpected direction.
Only those with a strong will\nare capable of stopping the flow\nthat has gone awry.
From here on, a number of paths\nwill present themselves to you.
Down each of them, you will witness\nthe karma of those you meet.
But whatever path you choose,\nremember that the choice was\nyours and no one else's.
How are you, friends?
Just as you thought, this world is\na counterfeit of your own.
It is this world where\nKandori's ambitions lie.
If you pursue him, you will eventually\ndiscover the nature of this world\nand how to return to your home world.
Kandori has made his fortress\non the east side of town,\nwhere he is searching for something.
Should it fall into his hands, there will be\nno tomorrow for either world.
You must stop Kandori.
The first step is to use\nthe subway terminal to reach\nthe east side of town.
But, the gate has a guardian.\nLook for the Expel Mirror.
Well done in returning here.
I see my faith in you\nwas not misplaced.
The Alaya Cavern behind this shrine\nleads to the sea of all mankind's souls.
All souls are born there\nand someday return there.
Maki Sonomura's soul is about\nto return to that sea right now.
It calls for you and for her ideal self.
Now go!
Only those who have been called\nmay enter that cavern.
Warp together to help the lost soul.
A moment, please.
You are angry and frustrated,\nbut that will not rescue your teacher.
There is only one way to do that:\nthe demon mirror.
It can remove the source\nof the mask's curse.
However, the Snow Queen\nhas shattered it. The twelve shards\nare scattered amongst three towers.
Take this mirror frame with you.
Fit the mirror shards you find into it.
If you gather enough shards\nto reflect your teacher,\nshe can be saved.
There isn't much time left.
I pray for your success.
How are you doing, friends?
This is a world of dreams, ruled by\nthe Persona Hypnos of this tower's master.
Hypnos is currently trapping\npeople's souls and confining them\nin the dream world.
Thus, this is a crossroad\nbetween the dream world and reality.
Either go to the dream world\nand awaken the people there
or continue forth and defeat Hypnos -
the choice is yours.
But remember: there is a limit\nto the time you are given.
Nothing more need be said.
I'm sure you have all discovered\nby now your true selves.
The smiles you wear are no longer\nfalse masks.
You may find yourselves troubled\nor suffering or lost in the future,\nbut there is nothing to fear.
Look to your soul for your true self.
No matter what trials you may face,\nthat will be enough for you\nto weather the storm.
Now go forth
into your bright futures.
